sloka: तत्र म्लेच्छान् पुलिन्दान् च शूरसेनान् तथैव च ।प्रस्थालान् भरतान् चैव कुरूम् च सह मद्रकैः ॥४-४३-११॥
transliteration: tatra mlecchān pulindān ca śūrasenān tathaiva ca ।prasthālān bharatān caiva kurūm ca saha madrakaiḥ ॥4-43-11॥

translations.english: 'Search in the countries of Mlechas, Pulindas, Surasenas, Prasthalas, Bharatas, Madrakas, Kurus, Kambojas and even Yavanas, Shakas, Rattakas, Bahlikas, Rishikas, Pauravas, Tankanas, Cheenas, Paramacheenas, Niharas, Daradas and in the Himalaya mountains again and again in order to find her.
